description: Replaces one priced line of a planned trip's option with one of the numbered choices from find_trip_item_alternatives, and re-prices the whole option as the website does. Use it only after the traveller has picked one of those choices. Returns the updated option and its Safe Trip Total before and after. Side effects: the trip saved on Trip720 is changed and the line it had is replaced (it can be chosen back the same way while it is still offered); calling it again swaps again. Nothing is booked or paid.
